Title: Chocolate Cake
Ingredients:
1. 3 eggs
2. 1 cup granulated sugar
3. 1 cup milk
4. ½ cup vegetable oil
5. 2 tbsp cocoa powder
6. 1 packet baking powder
7. 2 cups all-purpose flour
Steps:
1. Beat the eggs and granulated sugar until foamy.
2. Add the milk and vegetable oil and stir to combine.
3. Sift the all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder into the batter.
4. Pour the batter into a greased cake pan and bake for 35 minutes in an oven preheated to 350°F.
